summary: Element-wise 2x2 transform: writes two floats into the output pointer a1 (offsets 0 and 4) computed as a row-vector times a 2x2 matrix, where the matrix is read through a3 with a column stride of 4 floats (a3[0], a3[1] and a3[4], a3[5]) and the input vector is read through a2. Returns the output pointer a1 unchanged.

local_names.a1: output float pair written at offsets 0 and 4
local_names.a3: 2x2 matrix with 4-float column stride (a3[0]/a3[1] first column, a3[4]/a3[5] second column)

operations.description: Compute v6 = a3[4] * a2[1] + a2[0] * a3[0], the first output component.
Compute v3 = a3[1] * a2[0], the first term of the second output component.
Compute v4 = a3[5] * a2[1], the second term of the second output component.
Write v6 to a1[0], the output float at field offset 0.
Compute v7 = v3 + v4 to form the second output component.
Write v7 to a1[1], the output float at field offset 4.
Return the output pointer a1 unchanged.

clean_pseudocode: float c0 = mat[4] * vec[1] + vec[0] * mat[0];
float c1 = mat[1] * vec[0] + mat[5] * vec[1];
